summary: LakeShore Biopharma filed a 6-K announcing shareholder approval of its going-private merger with Oceanpine Skyline Inc. At an EGM, ~86.2% of votes cast approved the Merger Agreement dated November 4, 2025, as amended. Merger Sub will merge into the Company, which will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. Post-merger, shares and warrants will be delisted from OTC Pink and deregistered under Section 12. The transaction is subject to customary conditions. Watch for regulatory approvals in the Cayman Islands and the closing timeline; risk-arb focuses on deal completion and any remaining conditions.
